lines.text: Chin up, tomorrow will be better.

data.define: Used to encourage someone who is sad.

example.text: Chin up, tomorrow will be better.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chin up' to someone crying hard.

data.l1_hook: Journée difficile, mais demain arrive, alors \"chin up\" !
